apiContracts: Search query text is trimmed and capped at 120 characters.
External search fan-out includes at most eight enabled connectors with rights_status='authorized'.
Each external connector response must be successful JSON and is limited to 1 MiB while streaming.
Malformed, non-JSON, failed or oversized provider responses are treated as unavailable; local catalog results remain available.
Existing response shape, result normalization, rights filters and deduplication remain unchanged.
dataEntities: Reuses the existing connectors registry; no new entity or persisted provider response.

migrationPlan.canonicalEntityReuse: The existing connectors table remains the sole connector registry.
migrationPlan.backwardCompatibility: The public search response shape is unchanged. Oversized or non-JSON provider responses now fail closed for that provider while local results remain available.
migrationPlan.rollbackOrForwardRepair: Revert the Worker helper, route integration, regression test and build registration. No database repair is required.

privacySecurity.authorization: Only enabled connectors with rights_status='authorized' are queried; the existing HTTPS host allowlist remains mandatory.
privacySecurity.ownerScoping: No user-owned records are read or modified by the external response parser.
privacySecurity.rateAndSizeLimits: 120-character query limit, eight-provider fan-out limit, seven-second existing timeout and 1 MiB streamed body limit per provider.
privacySecurity.rightsAndPrivacy: Only provider metadata already permitted by the connector authorization policy is normalized; no chapter body is fetched or stored.

integration: Source-level route assertions confirm GET /api/omni/search uses the bounded parser, retains local catalog fallback and preserves the authorized-connector filter.
Exact-head Cloudflare Source Validation exercises the mandatory build; no live provider or production D1 call is part of this change.

stagingSteps: Pass Architecture Governance, Route Registry, Runtime Schema Parity, Migration Governance and Graphify.
Review connector failure behavior and local-result fallback before separately approved deployment.

rollback.codeRollback: Revert the bounded parser and OmniPortal route changes.
rollback.dataRollbackOrForwardRepair: No schema or production data change.
monitoringSignals: Oversized and non-JSON provider responses are rejected.
Local catalog results remain available when external providers fail.
Provider fan-out never exceeds eight authorized connectors.

collisionReview.duplicateRoutes: No route is added or removed; existing GET /api/omni/search behavior receives bounded input and response parsing.
collisionReview.sharedSurfaceOwners: Worker changes require platform-kernel review; tests are owned by platform-quality; package script by repository-operations; architecture records by platform-architecture.

changeSummary: Bounds OmniPortal search inputs, provider fan-out and external JSON bodies while preserving rights gates, local catalog results and the existing response contract.
acceptanceCriteria: External JSON bodies are streamed and capped at 1 MiB per provider.
Non-JSON, malformed and failed provider responses are rejected without breaking local search.
Search query length is capped at 120 characters.
Only the first eight enabled rights-authorized connectors are queried.
Regression tests are registered in the mandatory build.
The exact PR head passes all required governance and Cloudflare validation workflows.
